title: What Is Inflation?
paragraphs: Last year, a loaf of bread cost a little money. This year, the same bread costs more. When many prices go up like this, we call it inflation.
With inflation, our money buys less. You have the same money, but you can buy fewer things.
Why do prices go up? Sometimes many people want to buy, but there are not many things to sell. Sometimes energy, like oil, costs more, so making things costs more.
Every country has a central bank. When prices go up too fast, the bank can make loans more expensive. Then people spend less, and prices go up more slowly.
